description: Somalia - Airports is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Somalia. Air transport plays an essential role in providing aid and relief during and after a disaster. Airports are important hubs for humanitarian assistance and disaster response. The continued support and influx of goods and supplies is dependent on air transport. Coverage: Somalia. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Somalia. Its tags are aviation, transportation. It offers 3 resource(s) in SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
